title: 第一章 若是有来生，伴君天下舞！
slug: 傲世九重天全本免费-傲世九重天最新章节列表
content_zh:
这里，便是九重天大陆，上三天，一处绝地，风雷台！
上可接风雷，出入一线天！
但此刻，风雷台上，却是一片腥风惨雾！
“楚阳，交出九劫剑！饶你不死！”
“楚阳，你已经死到临头，还是交出九劫剑吧。我等可以为你留一个全尸！”
“楚阳，九劫剑这等天下第一神物在你手上，纯属浪费，多少年了，你毫无进展，根本就是暴敛天物！还是交出来吧。……”
一阵阵喧嚣的叫声从四面八方传来。
风雷台中央，微微凸起的一块大石头上，楚阳一身黑衣，浑身浴血，披头散发，但脸上，却是恒久的冷漠。眼中神色，依然如磐石一般冷静凝定！－身躯，依然如标枪一般笔直！
正如他手中的剑，充满了宁折不弯的意味！
纵然他已经受了致命重伤！
在他的脚下，四周方圆数百丈之内，无数的残肢断体，鲜血淋漓。
看着四周一片只是呼喊，但却并不冲过来的一众高手们，楚阳脸上露出了一丝讥诮的笑，傲慢而不屑！
面对这如云高手，纵然他已经山穷水尽，却还是傲气冲天！
这些人都打得好算盘。他们知道自己现在虽然已经是油尽灯枯，但无论谁上来，都要面对自己同归于尽的一击，谁也不愿意当那个垫背的。只盼望有人愣怔怔的冲上来找死。但却谁也不傻，所以他们干脆在这时候竟然不约而同的停了手。
这样的人，这样的心性，修为再高，人数再多；纵然可以杀我一万次，也不配与我为敌！
楚阳讥诮的笑着，缓缓坐了下来，脸上虽然仍旧声色不动，口中依然一言不发。但心中，却充满了疑惑。
九劫剑在自己手中的事情，怎么会泄露出去的？
自己明明前后考察了三年才确定这上三天风雷台中有第九劫剑的一截剑身，费尽千辛万苦，才终于找机会冒着九死一生的危险来到上三天，但为何自己来到了这里之后，却遇到了如此声势浩大的埋伏？
今日，自己进入上三天，也才不过第五天而已！刚刚寻找到风雷台，就遭遇了这次伏击！
今日之局，纯粹死局！

自己一向以行踪诡秘出名，谁知道自己的计划？
自己连续冲了十几次，每一次，都被人挡了回来！而自己选择的这些地方，都是属于死角！按常理来说，自己绝无冲不出去的道理！
是谁如此了解自己的习惯？这个暗中的敌人，是谁？
这个问题，已经困扰了楚阳很久。
九劫剑闪亮的剑身，映照着天上的日光，便如在半空中画出了一道长虹。所有看到这一幕的人，都是心头火热。恨不得那神物就握在自己手中！
上古神物！九重天大陆第一神物！
谁得到了九劫剑，谁就能天下无敌！九劫剑之中，就有这个天下无敌的大秘密！据传说，九劫剑的威力，还不止于此。
九劫九重天，一剑灭世间；千秋尊万古，九重天外天！
这是世间流传的关于九劫剑的唯一的一句歌谣。来处已不可考。九劫剑，一向都只是一个传说，谁也没想到，有一天九劫剑竟然真的出现在自己面前。
…………………………
楚阳心中也在疑问。九劫剑，不错，自己是得到了九劫剑，而且一步一步的寻找到了五截剑身。但他却失望的发现，九劫剑的威力并不是想象之中的大！而且，自己与九劫剑之间，始终有一道明确的隔阂。无论自己用鲜血浇灌，还是用自己的诚心感悟，都没有丝毫效果。这是为什么？
为何？为何？！
极于情，极于剑！自己灭情入剑，以剑道入武道，以武道求天道，以终身孤独为代价，以遍地杀戮为度世宝筏，可惜终究还是不能练成九劫剑，练成九重天神功！！
是自己选择错误？还是这条路根本就是错误的？或者说……自己的无情，还未能符合于九劫剑？
无情剑客无情剑客，剑客若有情，还算什么剑客？剑道武道天道，终究都是无情的……可生死之际的现在，为何却如此动摇？
九劫剑啊九劫剑，你的秘密，究竟是什么？！
看着四周贪婪地盯着九劫剑的目光，楚阳心中苦笑一声。你们只知道得到这九劫剑就能天下无敌，但你们可知道，我为了这九劫剑，付出了多少？
什么都没有了啊。
一条红色的曼妙人影，似乎在脑海中闪现，越来越是清晰，慢慢的红袖轻扬，冥冥中，似乎有飘渺的音乐响起，而那曼妙身影，就在一片虚无飘渺中缓缓起舞……

content_en:
Here is the Nine Heavens Continent, three days above, a desperate place, the Wind and Thunder Platform!
You can pick up wind and thunder, and go in and out of the sky!
But at this moment, on the Fenglei Platform, there was a bloody mist!
"Chu Yang, hand over the Nine Tribulations Sword! I will spare your life!"
"Chu Yang, you are on the verge of death, so you should hand over the Nine Tribulations Sword. We can leave a whole body for you!"
"Chu Yang, it is a complete waste for you to have the world's most sacred object such as the Nine Tribulations Sword in your hands. You have made no progress for many years. You are simply hoarding natural objects! You'd better hand it over. ..."
Bursts of noisy shouts came from all directions.
In the center of the wind and thunder platform, on a slightly raised large stone, Chu Yang was dressed in black, covered in blood, with disheveled hair, but his face showed a permanent indifference. The look in his eyes is still as calm and steady as a rock! -The body is still as straight as a javelin!
Just like the sword in his hand, it is full of meaning that he would rather break than bend!
Even though he has been fatally injured!
Under his feet, within a radius of several hundred feet, were countless stumps and broken bodies, dripping with blood.
Looking at the group of masters who were shouting but not rushing over, Chu Yang showed a sarcastic smile on his face, arrogant and disdainful!
Facing such a master, even though he was at the end of his rope, he was still so arrogant!
These people are very calculating. They know that although they are now exhausted, no matter who comes up, they will face a blow that will kill them all, and no one is willing to be the backer. I just hope that someone will rush forward looking for death. But no one was stupid, so they stopped in unison at this time.
Such people, with such character, no matter how high their cultivation level or how many there are, even if they can kill me ten thousand times, they are not worthy of being my enemy!
Chu Yang smiled sarcastically and slowly sat down. Although his face remained expressionless, he remained silent. But my heart was full of doubts.
How could it be leaked that the Nine Tribulations Sword was in his hands?
He had obviously spent three years investigating before confirming that there was a section of the Ninth Tribulation Sword in the Wind and Thunder Platform of Shangsantian. After going through a lot of hardships, he finally found the opportunity to risk nine deaths and come to Shangsantian. But why did he encounter such a massive ambush after he came here?
Today, I have entered the last three days, but it is only the fifth day! Just when we found the Fenglei Tower, we encountered this ambush!
Today's situation is a dead end!
He has always been known for his secretive whereabouts, who knows his plan?
I rushed a dozen times in a row, but every time, I was blocked by someone! And these places I chose are all blind spots! According to common sense, there is no reason why I can't rush out!
Who knows their own habits so well? Who is this secret enemy?
This problem has troubled Chu Yang for a long time.
The shining blade of the Nine Tribulations Sword reflected the sunlight in the sky, as if a rainbow was drawn in mid-air. Everyone who saw this scene was filled with excitement. I wish I could hold that divine object in my hands!
Ancient artifact! The number one divine object in Jiuchongtian Continent!
Whoever gets the Nine Tribulations Sword will be invincible! In the Nine Tribulations Sword, there is this great secret that is invincible in the world! According to legend, the power of the Nine Tribulations Sword does not stop there.
Nine tribulations and nine heavens, one sword destroys the world; Qianqiu Zun is eternal, nine heavens and the outer world!
This is the only ballad about the Nine Tribulations Sword circulating in the world. The place of origin is no longer known. The Nine Tribulations Sword has always been just a legend. No one expected that one day the Nine Tribulations Sword would actually appear in front of them.
……………………
Chu Yang also had questions in his mind. The Nine Tribulations Sword, yes, I got the Nine Tribulations Sword, and found the five sword blades step by step. But he was disappointed to find that the power of the Nine Tribulations Sword was not as powerful as he imagined! Moreover, there is always a clear barrier between himself and the Nine Tribulations Sword. regardlessNo matter whether you water it with your own blood or use your sincerity to realize it, it will have no effect at all. why is that?
Why? Why? !
Extremely strong in love and extremely strong in swordsmanship! He extinguished his love and entered the sword, entered the martial arts with the sword, sought the way of heaven with the martial arts, paid the price of lifelong loneliness, and used killing all over the world as a treasure raft to save the world. Unfortunately, he still could not master the Nine Tribulations Sword and the Nine Heavenly Divine Skills! !
Did you make the wrong choice? Or is this path simply wrong? In other words... my ruthlessness is not consistent with the Nine Tribulations Sword?
A ruthless swordsman is a ruthless swordsman. If a swordsman has feelings, what kind of swordsman is he? Swordsmanship, martial arts, and heaven are all ruthless after all... But now, at the time of life and death, why are you so shaken?
Nine Tribulations Sword, Nine Tribulations Sword, what is your secret? !
Seeing the eyes around him staring greedily at the Nine Tribulations Sword, Chu Yang smiled bitterly in his heart. You only know that if you get this Nine Tribulations Sword, you will be invincible in the world, but do you know how much I paid for this Nine Tribulations Sword?
There is nothing left.
A graceful red figure seemed to flash in my mind, becoming more and more clear. Slowly, the red sleeves fluttered slightly. In the dark, there seemed to be ethereal music playing, and the graceful figure danced slowly in the ethereal nothingness...
